preconditions.description: The number of elements in the given array is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each element in the array is an integer between -10^9 and 10^9, inclusive.
The cost of the first type operation is between 0 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimal cost required to make all the integers in the array greater than or equal to zero.
